opening.argument: The discussion centers on Polkadot/USDT support and resistance, with price movements presented as possibilities rather than guaranteed returns. The speaker expressly allows that the price can go lower. The description does promote exchange bonuses and account links, but it identifies those links as affiliate links and discloses that the creator receives a commission when viewers use them to start accounts. It also warns that using a cryptocurrency platform can result in a complete loss of funds. Taken together, the technical analysis, downside scenario, affiliate disclosure, and risk warning support reading this as market commentary with disclosed promotions, not a promise of returns.
